CREATE EXTERNAL TABLE dbo.customer_segmentation
(
    customer_id INT,
    first_name VARCHAR(100),
    last_name VARCHAR(100),
    email VARCHAR(255),
    gender VARCHAR(50),
    customer_status VARCHAR(50),
    total_orders BIGINT,
    total_spend DECIMAL(23,2),
    average_order_value DECIMAL(13,2),
    last_order_date DATETIME2,
    recency_days INT,
    recency_score INT,
    frequency_score INT,
    monetary_score INT,
    customer_segment VARCHAR(100),
    segmentation_timestamp DATETIME2
)
WITH
(
    LOCATION = 'synapse_serving/customer_segmentation/',
    DATA_SOURCE = EcommerceGold,
    FILE_FORMAT = ParquetFormat
);


SELECT TOP 10 * FROM dbo.customer_segmentation;

SELECT COUNT_BIG(*) AS total_rows
FROM dbo.customer_segmentation;
